description: For unary predicate symbols \(P,Q\), the premises \(\forall x\,(P(x)\to Q(x))\) and \(\exists x\,P(x)\) derive \(\exists x\,Q(x)\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.witness_implication.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  (P Q : L.Relations 1) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives
    {((Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.unaryBody P).imp
          (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.unaryBody Q)).all,
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.unaryBody P).ex}
    (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.unaryBody Q).ex
